mentions.name: Noun Sense
mentions.description: A daily word association game. The developer is rerunning the score data to combine the most common British and American spelling variations (e.g., colour/behaviour) so scores are fairer for players using British English, and a multiplayer version of the game is also in development.
mentions.problem: Players from the UK complained they scored lower when using British spelling variations of words like colour or behaviour.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on my daily word association game 'Noun Sense'. Had quite some people from the UK complaining that they were scoring lower with the British variations of words like colour or behaviour. Going to rerun the data crunching and combine the most common ones so the scores will be more "fair"
